node.statement: The tangent bundle identified in the preceding step is the same intrinsic tangent bundle on which the external theorem already supplies omega_U(Z)=(L_U^{-1}Z)^par as a global C1 bundle trivialization, with distortion at most 1+Cbar*epsilon_r and identities omega_{cU}(cZ)=omega_U(Z), omega_U(iU)=iJ. Therefore they hold together with the newly established tangent formula for the arbitrary family g, completing node 1.3 without the missing antecedent flagged by the verifier.
